title: score (Critic verdict, one per turn)
description: The Critic's turn output. There is no weighted total on purpose: the gate already answers 'do the tests pass?', so re-grading that with invented numbers adds noise and false confidence. The instrument is narrative gaps plus a verdict.

stance.description: This turn's adversarial stance from the rotation. Rotation is the anti-collusion defence, not decoration.

gate_verdict.description: Derived from the orchestrator's verification file, never from the Builder's claim.

tests_reviewed.description: Every test the Builder added or changed, read and judged. 'tautological' means it would pass against an obviously wrong implementation - the most common way a green suite proves nothing.

red_proof_reviewed.description: Was each case actually observed failing before it passed, and does the recorded proof still match the current contract?

gaps_the_gate_cannot_see.description: The Critic's core output: honest gaps a green gate does not catch, tied to a clause or case id wherever possible.

verdict.description: pass = gate green AND no blocking gap. revise = specific fixable issues (the common mid-loop verdict). block = fundamental: a clause has no honest test, a test is tautological, a shortcut was taken to go green, or the contract is unsatisfiable.

highest_impact_change.description: REQUIRED when verdict is not pass. One concrete, single-turn-actionable sentence. 'Improve it' wastes a turn.
